title: elymus asper
intro: Elymus asper, commonly known as the prairie junegrass or prairie wildrye, is a perennial grass native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Elymus asper include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and lignans, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
